# The Hira Store

> Handcrafted silver and fine jewelry made for everyday wear — earrings, necklaces, bangles and bracelets, pendants, rings and accessories. 252 pieces from $15 to $1,100, shipped from San Jose, California.

Prices are in US dollars. Most pieces are one of a kind: once sold, a piece leaves the shop.

## Policies
- Shipping: free within the US on orders of $100 or more; a flat $5 below that. Packed by hand and dispatched within 2-3 working days.
- Returns: within 30 days of delivery. Damaged or wrong items are repaired, replaced or refunded, return postage paid by the store. Unworn pieces in their original packaging can be returned at the customer's cost; worn earrings and made-to-order pieces cannot. Details: https://hirastore.techbirdit.in/help/
- Warranty: one year against manufacturing defects.
- Payment: by card at checkout.
- Video call: shoppers can book a video call to see pieces live before buying.

## Contact
- Email: info@Thehirastore.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thehirastore/
- Studio: San Jose, California, USA
